summary: NetEase, Inc. furnished a Form 6-K on September 24, 2026, attaching its Interim Report 2026 as Exhibit 99.1. The filing satisfies Hong Kong Listing Rule 13.48(1), requiring a half-year interim report for the six months ending December 31, 2026, equivalent to a US semi-annual financial report. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are disclosed. The 6-K is a routine periodic-reporting obligation, not a special situation. Watch for interim financials, segment trends, and share-repurchase or dividend commentary, but no risk-arb angle applies.
